answers.core: The editor settings themselves are core. If there's a way to do it from a project, then this might make a nice add-on; but I'm not convinced that there is, as only tool scripts have access to the editor.
answers.workaround: I have not yet found a way to set an editor theme for a specific project. It might be possible, but I haven't discovered it.

title: Allow editor theme overrides in project settings
